description: Compass: run your whole life out of Obsidian. Daily questions, quarterly retreats, planning, habits, tasks, writing, and an AI assistant in the vault.
summary: I like that Compass keeps the entire system as plain Markdown with a single config file (Meta/Compass Config.md) whose property prefixes drive every dashboard, so you change one note and the whole vault reshapes itself without touching a plugin. The AI layer is the part that actually interests me: it reads AGENTS.md, runs a fixed library of approval-aware prompts, and the MCP bridge is a read-only tool allowlist, which is the same constrained, observable agent pattern I build into AgentOn Pocket and PenguPool. It's a useful reference for how to make a local-first personal system that an LLM can actually operate without you babysitting every prompt.
